name: Boon Of Bountiful Health
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Augmented Health
features.description: When you gain Temporary Hit Points, increase the number of Temporary Hit Points you gain by 5.

features.name: Superior Recuperation
features.description: When you spend one or more Hit Point Dice to regain Hit Points, you can instead use the highest number possible for each die.
